newsitem.title: IRAQ: Iraq, Iran exchange remains of soldiers.
newsitem.headline: Iraq, Iran exchange remains of soldiers.

text.p: Iraq and Iran on Monday exchanged remains of soldiers missing in action in their 1980-1988 war, the official Iraqi News Agency INA said.
It said bodies were handed over to officials at Shalamcheh border east of Basra in southern Iraq. INA gave no figures.
Iraq and Iran signed an agreement in 1995 on mutual relations and the issue of prisoners of war and remains of soldiers, but did not announce the details.
Both have exchanged several hundred POWs and remains of soldiers.
The missing in action and POWs are among the thorniest issues hindering efforts to improve relations.
Iraq denies holding any more Iranians and says more than 20,000 Iraqis are still jailed in Iran. Tehran denies this and says Baghdad still holds 5,000 to 10,000 Iranian prisoners.
